subject: MAP Draft: SDK + Streaming + Tool-calling Integration — owners & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Ramos <alex@pulsecare.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@pulsecare.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Discovery — next steps & MAP milestone (SDK + streaming)

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the call today. As promised, attached is a lightweight MAP draft focused on the integration milestone we discussed: SDK integration, streaming responses, tool-calling hooks, and structured output validation. High-level recap below and proposed owners/timeline so we can align next week.

Recap (call highlights)
- Goal: Proof-of-concept integration that demonstrates streaming chat + tool-calls for appointment search and structured patient summary output.
- Primary success criteria: end-to-end demo with <500ms token latency under 2 concurrent demo users; deterministic structured JSON output for patient-summary schema.
- Constraints: PulseCare uses a HIPAA-compliant VPC, requires audit logs and KMS for key management.

Proposed MAP milestone (integration-build) — draft
- Milestone name: SDK integration + streaming/tool-calling POC
- Target close date: 2026-08-21 (6 weeks)
- Deliverables: SDK integration guide for PulseCare stack, streaming sample app, tool-calling adapter for appointment service, structured-output validation tests, brief runbook for deployment in your VPC.
- Owners (Redwood / PulseCare):
  - Redwood SDK integration lead: Rishi Malhotra (technical contact)
  - Redwood PM / deal owner: Marissa Cole (commercial & MAP coord)
  - PulseCare eng lead: Eric Lo (integration owner)
  - PulseCare product: Priya Shah (acceptance criteria)
- Dependencies: KMS credentials exchange, access to staging appointment API (sandbox), test patient dataset (anonymized), PulseCare security review window.

Action items (for next 7 days)
1) PulseCare to confirm acceptance criteria and provide staging API credentials (Alex / Eric) — due 2026-07-13
2) Redwood to share SDK integration patterns + streaming guide and fill out MAP spreadsheet — Marissa / Rishi — due 2026-07-12 (attached)
3) Schedule technical pairing session (30–60m) with PulseCare eng — Rishi / Eric — propose 2 slots next week

I attached the MAP spreadsheet and a short SDK pattern doc. If the owners/timeline look off, call it out and we can adjust. If you agree, I'll enter this version into HubSpot and lock the target close date.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: pulsecare_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), sdk-integration-patterns.pdf (implementation notes)

Subject: Re: MAP Draft: SDK + Streaming + Tool-calling Integration — owners & timeline

Marissa — thanks for the crisp recap and the MAP. We reviewed it internally this morning. A few quick notes:

1) Target close date: 2026-08-21 is OK from a business standpoint but we have a security review window that could push acceptance by a week if artifacts arrive late. Can Redwood kick the SDK guide + streaming sample app by end of day Tuesday (2026-07-14)? That will let us start the security intake.

2) Staging credentials: Eric will share a temporary sandbox API key and a small anonymized dataset by EOD Tue.

3) Owners: Eric is the integration owner; Priya will own acceptance, Alex to manage procurement steps.

We agree to the success criteria but want to add one more: metrics for structured-output accuracy (precision@schema fields) — will validate during test runs.

We'll accept the MAP draft and move forward pending the SDK artifacts.

—Alex

Alex / Eric — looping in the engineering plan and a short checklist so PulseCare has transparency on owners and what we'll deliver.

Engineering plan (summary)
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff + credential exchange; Redwood delivers sample streaming client and tool-calling adapter (Node + Python snippets).
- Week 1: Pairing sessions (30–60m) to validate sandbox connectivity and run first streaming sessions.
- Week 2–3: Implement structured-output schema enforcement in the sample app; add unit tests that validate schema fields and an acceptance script PulseCare can run.
- Week 4: Performance tuning and minimal quantization profile to replicate demo latency targets; smoke tests under 2 parallel demo users.
- Week 5: Final acceptance run and runbook delivery; handoff to PulseCare for deployment in staging.

Owner assignments (detailed)
- Redwood SDK integration lead: Rishi Malhotra — responsible for sample app, code review, pairing sessions. Contact: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
- Redwood SRE/Perf: Karthik Iyer — perf tuning, telemetry config, batching/profile advice. Contact: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
- Redwood PM / MAP lead: Marissa Cole — commercial checkpoints, acceptance criteria signoff.
- PulseCare eng owner: Eric Lo — provide sandbox API and test dataset; validate integration on staging.
- PulseCare product owner: Priya Shah — acceptance signoff on structured output and demo script.

Technical open questions (please confirm)
1) Staging API auth model: API key vs mTLS — Eric, you mentioned a key today. Confirm exact mechanism.
2) Data friction: will PulseCare provide an anonymized dataset or do we run with synthetic examples?
3) Tool-calling contract: provide OpenAPI spec or a short stub of appointment-search endpoints?

I'll upload code snippets to a shared repo once we confirm auth. Proposed pairing slots: Wed 2026-07-15 09:00-09:30 PT or 14:00-14:30 PT.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
